name: Tuuli
offer: A wood-fired lake sauna on a pine shore in Lahemaa, booked by the evening for up to six people.
audience: Friends and couples from Tallinn who want a quiet evening of heat, cold water and dark sky.
description: Tuuli: a wood-fired lake sauna in Lahemaa. Heat, the cold lake, and a sky with no city light. Book an evening for up to six.

sections.heading: Heat, cold water, and a *dark* sky.
body: A wood-fired sauna on a pine shore, an hour from Tallinn. Scroll down to the water.

sections.heading: An evening at Tuuli.
body: Four parts, at your own pace.

scene.alt: Night over a lake in a pine forest: a full moon and its path of light on the water, a small sauna with a glowing window and chimney smoke on the far shore

items.label: Arrive
items.title: The fire is already lit
items.body: We light the stove two hours before you come, so the sauna is at 80-90 °C when you step in.

items.label: Heat
items.title: Rounds of löyly
items.body: Water on the stones, birch whisks if you like, and as long as you want between rounds.

items.label: Cold
items.title: Down the jetty
items.body: The lake is 4 °C in winter and 20 °C in July. A ladder and a lit path, always.

items.label: Dark
items.title: No city light
items.body: Lahemaa has some of the darkest skies near Tallinn. On clear nights you see the Milky Way from the jetty.

sections.heading: Book an evening
body: Leave your email and we will send the free dates for the next month.
